analysis.purpose: Watch mode: keeps a working overlay fresh as files change, so the server can answer questions about uncommitted edits without dirtying the committed graph.
responsibilities: Refresh the overlay as the working tree changes
Treat the version-control scan as the source of truth
Use filesystem events only as a low-latency trigger, with a periodic backstop

businessRules.rule: The version-control scan is authoritative and the filesystem watcher is only a trigger, with a timed fallback.
businessRules.rationale: Filesystem events are unreliable across platforms; correctness cannot depend on them.

businessRules.rule: Edits are exposed through the overlay without writing to the committed graph.
businessRules.rationale: Keeps uncommitted work queryable without making the stored graph dirty.
